name: webook-kimiko-booking
description: Webook event sections fetcher and automated booking assistant

scripts.kill: powershell -Command "try { Import-Module NetTCPIP -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; try { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3456 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } catch {}; Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*server.js*' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue" || taskkill //F //IM node.exe //FI "WINDOWTITLE eq *server.js*" 2>nul || taskkill //F //IM node.exe 2>nul || true
